title: Moore Output Late by One Cycle (Registered State)
bug_signature: UVM_ERROR: [TIMING] gnt asserted 1 cycle after FSM enters GNT_STATE; handshake missed
rtl:
always_ff @(posedge clk)
  gnt <= (state == GNT_STATE) ? gnt_vec : 4'h0;  // Output lags state by 1
expected_root_cause: The grant output register is clocked from the current FSM state; since the output lags the state by one pipeline stage, the downstream handshake partner sees the grant one cycle after the FSM enters the grant state and misses the intended transfer window.
description: The grant output is registered from the current state, adding one pipeline stage; downstream logic receives the grant one cycle too late relative to the FSM transition.
failure_log: UVM_ERROR: [TIMING] gnt asserted 1 cycle after FSM enters GNT_STATE; handshake missed
success_log: gnt appears in the same cycle as FSM state transition. Handshake correct.
